```sql
WITH base AS (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_variant AS (
    SELECT product_id, variant_id,
           sum(quantity)         AS q,
           sum(line_total_cents) AS r
      FROM base
     GROUP BY product_id, variant_id
),
per_product AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           sum(q)::bigint AS quantity,
           sum(r)         AS revenue_cents,
           count(*)       AS variant_count
      FROM per_variant
     GROUP BY product_id
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS order_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, order_id FROM base) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       po.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       pp.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN per_order po ON po.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p   ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure `count(DISTINCT ...)`-aggregaten, die een sort van ruim 80.000 rijen via schijf (temp files) afdwongen, zijn vervangen door hash-aggregaties in stappen. Per variant wordt eerst gesommeerd (variant_count wordt dan een gewone `count(*)`), en order_count komt uit een aparte `SELECT DISTINCT product_id, order_id`. De datatypes blijven gelijk (`quantity` bigint, `revenue_cents` numeric), en de ORDER BY is ongewijzigd.
